provenance.seed_method: Highest historical-elevation vertex of the largest optical-supported NISAR event-change patch centered within the mountain extraction polygon.
provenance.route_method: Steepest D8 descent on priority-flood-filled buffered historical terrain; acyclic flood-tree routing on flats. Terminates at study boundary. No observed flow direction, speed, flood depth, debris volume or event travel time is inferred.
provenance.radar_method: Existing GCOV HH hotspot peaks and signed change sampled within 100 m of route vertices; 20 m sampling spacing. Null means no hotspot, not absence of debris. Valid coverage is separately retained.
